`document.hwp` and `document.hwpx` are generated SparkTalk test documents containing Korean text, a table and a four-color image. The browser tests use them to verify attachment transport and classification. Recreate them with `compose_yaml/sparktalk_extra/docms/validation/check-hancom.sh`, then copy `runs/hancom/sample.hwp` and `sample.hwpx` here. Document layout and independent parser tests run in that validation suite.
